pwa.title: INSTALL THE APP
pwa.descMobile: Add Aypik to your home screen to get back in one tap, without going through the browser.
pwa.descDesktop: Add Aypik to your desktop to get back in one click, without going through the browser.
pwa.waitingHint: It will offer to install once it's ready — sometimes after a visit or two, or if it has already shown its own banner.
pwa.iosButton: How to add it to your home screen
pwa.iosStep1: Tap the Share button (square with an arrow) at the bottom of Safari.
pwa.firefoxStep1: Tap the menu (three dots) in the top right.
pwa.firefoxStep2: Choose Install — or Add to Home Screen, depending on your Firefox version.
pwa.firefoxStep3: Confirm adding it to your home screen.
pwa.safariMacButton: How to add it to the Dock
pwa.safariMacStep1: In the menu bar, open File.
pwa.safariMacStep2: Choose Add to Dock (macOS Sonoma 14 and later). You can also use Safari's Share button, then Add to Dock.
pwa.safariMacStep3: Check the name, then click Add.

matches.whatToDoAria: What to do with this profile
matches.introBefore1: On this page you'll find every profile that has sent you a <study>Like or a Flash — to review</study>. You can either decline them (so they disappear from this page), <wait>put them on hold</wait> (to look at them again later), or <matcher></matcher> them to move these profiles on to the Matches stage.
matches.introBefore2: Profiles you've put on hold yourself appear under <holdYou>Put on hold by you</holdYou>. If it's the other person who put your Like or Flash on hold, you'll find it under <holdThem>Put on hold by them</holdThem>: you can view the profile, but the decision is theirs to make.
matches.introBefore3: You'll also find on this page every profile that has declined one of your Likes or Flashes. You can then choose to <purge>delete or archive them</purge>.
matches.introDuring: All your matches are grouped under either <quiet>First message</quiet>, for as long as there hasn't yet been a message from both sides (even if one of you has already written), or <chat>Conversations in progress</chat>, once each of you has sent at least one message.
matches.introAfter1: An already-confirmed match can be archived or ended from the conversation. You'll then find it under <brokenYou>Match ended by you</brokenYou> if you're the one who made that decision (you can restore it or delete it permanently), or under <brokenThem>Match ended by them</brokenThem> if it was the other person who chose to end the link (you can only delete it permanently).
matches.introAfter2: Your other matches, on the other hand, remain fully active and carry on as normal — and <encounters>new, happiness-filled encounters</encounters> are already on their way
matches.declinedHintBefore: You can either archive this profile
matches.declinedHintMid: to keep it on your "My Matches" page, or delete it
matches.declinedHintAfter: to remove it permanently from your page.
